achievements.title: The Departure
achievements.description: "So many times a man's thoughts will waver, that it turns him back from honored paths..."

achievements.title: A Heart's Resolve
achievements.description: "At grief so deep the tongue must wag in vain. The language of our sense and memory lacks the vocabulary of such pain."

achievements.title: Scars in the Heart
achievements.description: "Through me is the way to the city of woe. Through me is the way to sorrow eternal."

achievements.title: Music for a Moonless Sky
achievements.description: "From there we came outside and saw the stars."

achievements.title: Crossroads of Hatred
achievements.description: "There is no greater sorrow than to remember a happy time when you are in misery."

achievements.title: Embrace the Light
achievements.description: "Let him that would move the world first move himself."

achievements.title: Wings of the Enterprise
achievements.description: "As little flowers, which the chill of night has bent and huddled."

achievements.title: Partings and Reunions
achievements.description: "Do not be afraid, our fate cannot be taken from us! It is a gift!"

achievements.title: Savior of Mist
achievements.description: "Wisdom is earned, not given."

achievements.title: Pride of Fabul
achievements.description: "He did what any hero must: set sail..."

achievements.title: Forever Loved
achievements.description: "You were not made to live like brute beasts, but to pursue virtue and knowledge."

achievements.title: Mysidian Legend
achievements.description: "Soon you will be where your own eyes will see the answer to the mystery."

achievements.title: To the Dark Depths
achievements.description: "Here, all suspicion must be abandoned. All cowardice must be extinct."

achievements.title: Life's Triumph
achievements.description: "Our crystals and hopes shine once again!"

achievements.title: King of Eidolons
achievements.description: A powerful force awaits to judge the heroes in the depths of the planet

achievements.title: Loyal Friend
achievements.description: An old friend sleeps in the depths of a magical cave awaiting another harsh day of training

achievements.title: Sword of Justice
achievements.description: A righteous murdered king awaits in a solitary throne to hold his sacred sword once again

achievements.title: Trial of Omega
achievements.description: An ancient god awaits to judge the heroes at his throne high in the sky

achievements.title: The Steel and the Mist
achievements.description: Defeat the Mist Dragon without triggering its special attack

achievements.title: No Messengers Left
achievements.description: Kill all the officers of Baron who were sent to Kaipo

achievements.title: Tako Express
achievements.description: Defeat Octomammoth with at least 2 legs still out of the water

achievements.title: Explosive Sync

achievements.title: Malebranche of Earth
achievements.description: Defeat Scarmiglione with a single action directed at him

achievements.title: Minimalist Struggle
achievements.description: Battle against the traitor while everyone in the party is under the Mini status and win with every member alive

achievements.title: Malebranche of Water
achievements.description: Defeat Cagnazzo without letting him cast Haste on himself and without any party member dying

achievements.title: Winds of Victory
achievements.description: Defeat the true form of the Dark Elf by only directing two actions at it - maybe Tellah knows the answer?

achievements.title: Magical Miscalculation
achievements.description: Get Cindy knocked out by friendly fire during the Magus Sisters' Delta Attack

achievements.title: Malebranche of Wind

achievements.title: Danse Macabre

achievements.title: Malebranche of Fire

achievements.title: Fatal Error

achievements.title: Cosmic Duel

achievements.title: Siren's Pupil
achievements.description: In one session, successfully make enemies confused 3 times with the Bard's command "Sing"

achievements.description: Succesfully sing the elusive song that turns enemies into frogs

achievements.title: Salve of Salvation

achievements.title: Spoony Bard

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest I: Great Baron Falls
achievements.description: "Started my journey today! Look at this huge waterfall near Baron with [Y]!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest II: Damcyan Waterway
achievements.description: "Now I'm really tired of this long cave! You can see an exit on the other side with [Y]!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest III: Fabul Peninsula
achievements.description: "This is so close to Fabul! The monks prefer to train on the mountains though. Look at the sea with [Y]!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest IV: Sacred Vista
achievements.description: "Look at this wonderful view with [Y]! This sacred mountain is full of zombies even this close to its summit!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest V: Chocobo Kingdom
achievements.description: "Look at the eye of our home with [Y]! I will finally learn how to fly with my cousin today!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest VI: Beak Peninsula
achievements.description: "Look at this strange peninsula with [Y]! It looks like a beak of a giant bird!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest VII: Empty Throne
achievements.description: "Look at this huge throne with [Y]! Boko said I could see the ninjas here but the place is empty!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest VIII: Visiting the Creator
achievements.description: "Look at this dirty floor with [Y]! Mr. Taka promised to improve my design on the next game if I clean it right!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest IX: Underworld Crater
achievements.description: "Look at this huge crater with [Y]! Something must have exploded around here!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest X: Underworld Corner
achievements.description: "Look at this strange corner with [Y]! I think I have to go up north to reach the Sylph Cave."

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest XI: Ancient Library
achievements.description: "Look at those books with [Y]! Here is a book with good details on our great hero: Bokomesh IV!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest XII: Green Maze
achievements.description: "Look here with [Y]! I want to visit my sylph friends but I'm almost giving up on the B2F! Kweh!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest XIII: Extraterrestrial
achievements.description: "Look at this hill with [Y]! This is a great step for chocobokind!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest XIV: Wrong Cave
achievements.description: "This place is full of monsters! Look here with [Y], you can see a big throne on the other side!"

achievements.title: Chicobo Quest XV: Humming Heaven
achievements.description: "My friends here will send me back to Baron! Thank you for your company on my quest, kweh!"
